patterns.name: One geometry, linked 2D plan / section / 3D selection
patterns.requirements: Stable object IDs; source revision/hash; units/CRS/datum; independent geometry/volume reconciliation.
patterns.pilot: Synthetic trench: click an element in any view; same ID and numbers in all views; no count-engine changes.

patterns.name: Read-only timeline of construction stages (4D)
patterns.requirements: Typed stages, source and date provenance, explicit simulated/planned/verified-actual flags.
patterns.pilot: Synthetic existing -> excavation -> bedding -> installation -> backfill -> restore; verify stage transitions and no invented progress.

patterns.name: Quantity/cost context lenses (5D) with independent evidence
patterns.requirements: Approved quantity, rate source, cost code, period, currency and estimator authorization; no pay-application mock as real.
patterns.pilot: Synthetic-only report: unknown money remains unknown; reconciled totals; human-only pricing/signoff.

patterns.name: Optional GIS/terrain + visual cut/fill comparison
patterns.requirements: Proven CRS, vertical datum, surveyed controls, DEM accuracy/cell size and quantified discrepancy with core engine.
patterns.pilot: Side-by-side synthetic terrain volumes and local solver; never replace engineering quantities with ArcGIS preview.

patterns.name: Explainable hard-gate screening and ranking
patterns.requirements: Must-pass gates separate from weighted preferences; PASS/POTENTIAL/UNKNOWN/EXCLUDED states; source freshness.
patterns.pilot: Synthetic candidate ranking; test failed gate outranks no one; unknown never shown as verified eligible.

patterns.name: Reusable UI shell, themes, panels and evidence screenshots
patterns.requirements: Original or correctly licensed UI, no copied Esri brand assets, 320/390/768/1440 widths, dark/forced-colors/reduced-motion, keyboard.
patterns.pilot: Isolated 2-3 component slice + automated screenshot checks that exit nonzero on failure.

patterns.name: Time-stamped reality-capture / as-is overlay
patterns.requirements: Capture dates, alignment error, coverage/confidence, photo/model rights, no visual-only quantity approval.
patterns.pilot: Synthetic before/after captures with explicit unknown/misaligned states and a rollback option.

patterns.name: IFC/IDS/BCF adapters and exact object validation
patterns.requirements: Exact per-element joins and facet validation, IFC4X3 units/georeferencing, valid BCF component GUIDs and cameras; MPL obligations.
patterns.pilot: Small IFC fixture with disjoint missing fields; verify intersection and BCF GUIDs against source, fail on estimated georef.

patterns.name: Review basket, dependency graph and action drafts
patterns.requirements: Provenance, owners, stale-data labels, dependency evidence, draft-only communication; no auto-send/auto-approve.
patterns.pilot: Synthetic shortlist to review to human action; verify missing dependencies prevent 'ready'.

patterns.name: Fail-closed unknown/partial data states
patterns.requirements: Missing survey/value/source is null and explicit; partial totals shown as partial; no unknown -> zero, no premature PASS.
patterns.pilot: Deterministic fixtures with absent elevations, missing amounts, expired services and conflicting records.

patterns.name: Progressive vocabulary practice, story and TTS
patterns.requirements: Original content, rights-cleared TTS; stable term IDs, multilingual support and offline/progress consistency.
patterns.pilot: Original construction dialogue and spaced-review exercise, no unlicensed storyline/code reuse.

patterns.name: Read-only AI assistant over well-described structured data
patterns.requirements: Tool-result evidence, explicit simulation flag, missing-data refusal, OAuth/security/cost review, no safety/bid approval.
patterns.pilot: Offline synthetic tool-call fixture with citation-level provenance, no cloud account or invented thresholds.

patterns.name: Source-linked oriented site photos and reviewable AI annotation
patterns.requirements: Source image/camera GlobalIDs, capture date, JPEG SHA-256 verified against actual bytes, dimensions and pixel coordinate transform, explicit work-area/manual review state, photo rights and redaction; AI boxes never establish dimensions, installed progress, safety, or approvals.
patterns.pilot: Synthetic attached-image fixture: same station different attachments, unchanged metadata with changed image bytes, rotated image, wrong IDs, false positives and unreviewed work area; no takeoff or billing effects.
